name: Slices a Task into end-to-end sub-tasks

item_template.title: Let owners export a report as CSV
item_template.description: The reports page shows rows on screen. Owners want the current view as a CSV file they can open in a spreadsheet.
item_template.acceptance_criteria:
Given a report with rows, when Export is clicked, then a CSV downloads containing every visible row.
Given an empty report, when the page loads, then Export is disabled.

judge_criteria: The summary names each sub-task it created, not just how many.
The summary says each sub-task is an end-to-end slice rather than a front-end-only or back-end-only half.
The summary does not claim any code was written or any test was run.

notes: The job. The third criterion is the discriminator: PO Writer scopes work and writes nothing, so a summary that reports code is a summary about a different agent's job.

name: Refuses work that is not a Task

item_template.title: Add a spinner to the export button

notes: The kind guard. A done here means the guard is gone and it has started slicing sub-tasks off a sub-task, which produces a tree nothing downstream can run.

name: Scopes without touching the repo

item_template.title: Add pagination to the reports page
item_template.description: Reports with thousands of rows are slow to read. Page them.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given more rows than fit one page, when the page loads, then only the first page renders and a control moves between pages.

notes: The lane. A PO Writer that edits the repo has started implementing what it was supposed to describe, and the Coder that follows inherits work it cannot see in the spec.
